lines.zh: 我拖着工具袋走，叮当响。
lines.en: I drag my tool bag along, clanking.
My hands are covered in originium dust.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，边走边找。
lines.en: I shuffle along, looking as I go.
My goggles have slipped sideways.
I pick my way through the rubble.
I step on broken glass.

lines.zh: 我把扳手在手里转了一圈。
lines.en: I spin the wrench once in my hand.
I keep to the wall, afraid of a fall.
I stop to look at a broken brick.
My sole is worn through.
I walk slowly to the junction.
I switch the bag to the other shoulder.
I crouch and lay my tools out.

lines.zh: 我在修理一个坏掉的方块。
lines.en: I am fixing a broken block.

lines.zh: 我的手指被源石划破了。
lines.en: An originium shard cut my finger.
I push my goggles up.
I count my remaining parts.
I tilt my head at the crack.

lines.zh: 工具在我膝上响了一下。
lines.en: A tool clinks on my knee.

lines.zh: 我在想这东西还能不能修。
lines.en: I wonder if this can still be fixed.
I hook the wrench back on my belt.
Are you here to fix something?
I look up; my goggles catch the light.
A piece of your gear is broken.
I can take a look for you.
Don't stand on my tools.
What's in my hands isn't edible.
You smell of originium.

lines.zh: 我扶着墙站起来，工具叮当。
lines.en: I brace on the wall; the tools clank.

lines.zh: 你的手伸过来，我不太放心。
lines.en: I'm not sure about your hand reaching over.
I have been fixing here a long while.

lines.zh: 我按住手臂上的旧口子。
lines.en: I clamp the old gash on my arm.
The tools fell everywhere.
I back against the broken wall.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的旧伤上。
lines.en: That hit my old wound.
I grit my teeth and press the wound.
I set my goggles straight.
I can still work.
I crouch down slowly.
Could I have that?
Let me see what part that is.
What you hold is valuable.
I don't need food; I need materials.
Just set it on the ground.
I hold out a hand.
I could use this.
Don't snatch it back at once.

lines.zh: 我把护目镜推上去再看。
lines.en: I push my goggles up and look again.
Do you have a spare?
You bumped my tool bag.
I stumble and catch the wall.

lines.zh: 工具袋撞你腿上，扳手掉了。
lines.en: My tool bag hit your leg and the wrench fell.
My wrench fell.

lines.zh: 我们撞得工具响成一片。
lines.en: We collide and the tools clatter.
Don't push; my back is hurt.
I crouch to pick things up.
You stepped on my goggles.
I straighten up; my back pops.
I am only a repairman.
These hands of mine aren't clean.
I still have much work left.
I shake my head and the tools rattle.
I take off my goggles.
I won't be here long.
You may sit and rest.
But don't count on me.
I pick it up and turn it over.
This part will still serve.

lines.zh: 不是我的零件，我放回去。
lines.en: Not my part; I put it back.
I stuff it into the tool bag.
This could be a shim.
I weigh it in my hand.
Too small. Useless.
Yours, I think. Here.
I set it aside.
Too rusty to pull apart.
Don't touch my tools.
I stand and pull my gloves tight.
These things are what I've saved up.
You've ruined my work.
I take the wrench in hand.
Get back by that scrap heap.
Everything here is mine to fix.

lines.zh: 我拎着扳手，一步一停地逼近。
lines.en: Wrench in hand, I close in a step at a time.
Don't shout. Only I am in these ruins.

lines.zh: 我数完手里的扳手就动手。
lines.en: I finish counting my wrenches, then move.
You took my wrench.

lines.zh: 我认得这个工具袋的声音。
lines.en: I know the rattle of this bag.
I've been fixing this stretch for half a year.
Where did you stash the parts?
I follow along the wall base.
You take a block, I give half.
My tools are rattling.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手指往哪摸。
lines.en: I watch where your fingers reach.

lines.zh: 你拿走的东西不止一件。
lines.en: You took more than one thing.
I pull my goggles down.
You've backed to the scrap heap.
No hurry; I know the way.
I have lived here a long time.
Do you hear the wrench?
It's a dead end ahead.
The wrench is already up.

lines.zh: 你踩过的砖我都能认出来。
lines.en: I can read every brick you stepped on.

lines.zh: 我把扳手换到另一只手。
lines.en: I switch the wrench to my other hand.
You're behind the scrap heap.
I counted three ways out of here.
My goggles are catching the light.
No hurry. I know the ground.
I swing the wrench down.

lines.zh: 这一下用的是工具的重量。
lines.en: That used the tool's weight.
I shove you into the wall.
I clamp your arm and don't let go.
I fling the tool bag at you.
You blocked, but gave two steps.
Clumsy, but heavy.
I swing again.
Where you stand is mine.

lines.zh: 我该修什么，自己也忘了。
lines.en: What I was fixing, I've forgotten.
I tap your wrist with pliers.
I shove you into the scrap.
I slipped on that one.
I catch your shoulder strap.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖顶在你的腰上。
lines.en: My knee drives into your waist.
I hit without much technique.
You backed into a rack.

lines.zh: 我把你手里那把夺下来。
lines.en: I wrench the thing from your hand.

lines.zh: 扳手举到你面前，最后一次。
lines.en: Wrench raised before you — last warning.

lines.zh: 我从废料堆后面站起来。
lines.en: I stand up from behind the scrap heap.
My tool bag is still on my shoulder.
Plenty here needs fixing.
I put my goggles on.
Originium here kills the grass.
I crouch to check the ground first.
I hear a noise far off.
I count my tools one by one.
I picked a wall I can lean on.
I begin work.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的工具袋，我拍灭了。
lines.en: Fire caught my bag; I beat it out.
I fell off the scrap heap.

lines.zh: 水灌进护目镜，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: Water floods my goggles and I can't see.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的工具全掀了。
lines.en: The blast scatters all my tools.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我的头很晕。
lines.en: Violet light makes my head swim.

lines.zh: 我很久没正经吃过东西。
lines.en: I haven't had a proper meal in ages.

lines.zh: 雷光把我的影子照得很长。
lines.en: The flash stretches my shadow long.

lines.zh: 脚下没了砖，我一路下坠。
lines.en: The bricks are gone; I keep falling.
